stock.description: Home Control International Limited operates as an investment holding company, delivering advanced home control solutions across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America. The firm specializes in sensing and control technologies, with applications in smart home automation, consumer electronics, and set-top box industries. Beyond this, it engages in the direct sale of remote control devices and the trading and distribution of other home electronic goods. The company markets its products under the Omni Remotes brand, targeting television operators and leading consumer electronics manufacturers. Established in 1992, Home Control International Limited is headquartered in Singapore.
